1.w: For the one directing. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Turn your ear, O God, to my prayer, and do not hide Yourself from my supplication.

2.w: Be attentive to me, and answer me; [for] I am restless in my complaint, and make a noise,

3.w: from the voice of the enemy, from the face of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring down trouble upon me, and in anger they hate me.

4.w: My heart is writhing within me, and the terrors of death have fallen upon me.

5.w: Fear and trembling have come upon me, and shuddering has covered me.

6.w: And I said, “Who shall give to me a wing like a dove, [that] I might fly away and be at rest—

7.w: behold, I would go far off wandering [and] would lodge in the wilderness. Selah

8.w: I would hurry to shelter for myself, from the rushing wind, from the tempest.”

9.w: Swallow up, O Lord, divide their tongues! For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

10.w: Day and night they go around it, on its walls, and iniquity and trouble [are] within it.

11.w: Disasters [are] within it, and oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.

12.w: For [it is] not an enemy [who] scorns me, or I could bear it; and not one hating me [who] wielded power against me, or I could hide myself from him.

13.w: And [it was] you, a man like me in rank, my companion, and one known by me,

14.w: [with] whom we would take sweet counsel together; in the house of God we walked with the throng.

15.w: Devastation [is] upon them! May they go down alive [to] Sheol! For evils [are] in their dwellings, within them.

16.w: I will call to God, and YHWH will save me.

17.w: Evening and morning and noon I meditate and cry aloud, and He hears my voice.

18.w: In peace He has redeemed my soul from the battle against me, though there were many against me.

19.w: God will hear and afflict them—even He who sits of old—Selah with whom there are no changes for Him. And they have not fear God.

20.w: He has stretched out his hands against those united with him; he has profaned his covenant.

21.w: His mouth has been smoother than butter, and war [is] in his heart; his words have been softer than oil, and they [are] drawn swords.

22.w: Cast your burden upon YHWH, and He will sustain you; He will not give a righteous one to be shaken forever.

23.w: And You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction, men of blood and deceit! They will not live even half their days. And I will trust in You.
